report.incidentSummary: On 2026-09-09 at 14:00 IST (08:30 UTC), the scheduled afternoon redemption payout batch (PB-0909-PM) failed to process payouts for 1,987 users. Payout completion throughput dropped to zero, while pending payouts surged above 2,300. Around 14:19 IST (08:49:30 UTC), payout metrics dashboards also stopped updating. The incident was caused by database-level lock contention on the payout_instructions table: a one-off monthly AUM audit export job (aum-export) triggered at 13:50 IST (08:20 UTC) executed an exclusive lock query ('SELECT ... FOR UPDATE') that held row locks for hours, blocking the scheduled payout batch from acquiring write locks to execute payouts.
report.rootCauseStatement: A one-off audit export job ('aum-export') triggered via job-scheduler at 08:20:00 UTC executed a long-running 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE' transaction on the database (process 48213). This held exclusive row locks on the payout_instructions table, completely blocking the 14:00 IST (08:30:00 UTC) scheduled payout batch workers (PB-0909-PM) from acquiring RowExclusiveLock, stalling 1,987 redemptions and eventually starving payout-service's telemetry reporting pipeline.

hypotheses.cause: A one-off audit export job (aum-export) executed a long-running 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE' query on the database, acquiring and holding exclusive row locks on payout_instructions. This blocked the 14:00 IST scheduled payout batch (PB-0909-PM) from acquiring RowExclusiveLock to process and dispatch 1,987 redemption payouts.
hypotheses.rationale: Direct PostgreSQL database logs show process 48213 executing 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE (aum-export)' running for over 90 minutes and blocking multiple backend processes requesting RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions. Payout-service logs directly confirm that batch PB-0909-PM stalled waiting for this lock for over 7200 seconds.

hypotheses.cause: Partner bank API latency or failure upstream at bank-connector prevented payout dispatch.
hypotheses.rationale: Bank-connector p95 latencies across all partner banks remained normal between 1700ms and 2254ms throughout the entire window, timeout rates remained baseline (<=0.6/min), and bank-connector logged zero ERROR or FATAL entries.

hypotheses.cause: job-scheduler failed to trigger the 14:00 IST payout batch or experienced scheduling delays.
hypotheses.rationale: job-scheduler successfully triggered job payout-batch-pm (run_40233e58) exactly at 08:30:00 UTC, and payout-service acknowledged receipt and initialized batch PB-0909-PM at 08:30:06 UTC.

facts.statement: At 2026-09-09T08:20:00.000Z (13:50 IST), a one-off job 'aum-export' (monthly AUM export for auditors) was scheduled and initiated on job-scheduler via CHG-48223.
At 2026-09-09T08:30:00.000Z (14:00 IST), job-scheduler triggered job 'payout-batch-pm' (run_40233e58), and payout-service started batch 'PB-0909-PM' at 08:30:06Z with 1,987 queued redemptions.
Starting at 08:31:30Z and continuing past 10:41:09Z, payout-service repeatedly logged lock wait warnings on table 'payout_instructions', with wait durations exceeding 7,200 seconds.

Database logs show process 48213 executing 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE (aum-export)' blocked other processes attempting to obtain RowExclusiveLock on 'payout_instructions'.
payout-service metric 'payouts_completed_per_min' dropped to 0 at 08:30 UTC, while 'payouts_pending' jumped from ~226 to over 2,197 at 08:30 UTC and remained above 2,300.
payout-service metrics stopped emitting to the metrics datastore after 08:49:30 UTC.
bank-connector p95 latencies across all partner banks remained steady between 1.7s and 2.3s, timeout rates were normal (<=0.6/min), and zero ERROR logs were generated.

inferences.statement: Batch PB-0909-PM was unable to process any redemption transactions because worker threads were indefinitely blocked waiting for row locks held by the aum-export audit query.

The cessation of payout-service metric reporting after 08:49:30 UTC was caused by thread or database connection pool exhaustion resulting from prolonged lock wait states across backend worker threads.
Partner bank APIs and bank-connector played no role in the payout stall.

assumptions.statement: The aum-export job script opened an uncommitted transaction with a FOR UPDATE lock on payout_instructions that remained open throughout the entirety of its execution.
Payout-service has a shared connection/thread pool that, when exhausted by locked batch workers, blocked the metrics reporting exporter.

timeline.event: One-off job 'aum-export' scheduled and started via CHG-48223 on job-scheduler.
Scheduled payout batch 'payout-batch-pm' triggered by job-scheduler.
payout-service begins batch PB-0909-PM with 1,987 redemption requests queued.
payout-service encounters lock wait on payout_instructions table; payout completion throughput drops to 0.
Database logs confirm process 48213 (aum-export SELECT FOR UPDATE) is blocking RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions.
payout-service metrics cease reporting to the metric store due to thread/connection starvation.
payout-service logs continue reporting lock wait duration exceeding 7,200 seconds with 0 payouts sent.

confidence.rationale: Database logs explicitly identify the blocking PID (48213), the exact SQL query ('SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE (aum-export)'), and the blocked lock mode. Application logs in payout-service directly corroborate that batch PB-0909-PM has waited for over 7,200s on payout_instructions, while partner bank API health was independently confirmed normal.

gaps.description: Database metric queries for db_lock_wait_ms and active_connections timed out during investigation.
gaps.impact: Minimal impact because PostgreSQL engine logs provided direct, granular evidence of the blocking lock, query text, and waiting processes.

gaps.description: Exact root cause of payout-service metric exporter stoppage after 08:49:30 UTC could not be inspected via metrics store.
gaps.impact: Low impact on primary incident causality, as the timeline aligns with connection pool starvation induced by the database lock contention.

recommendedActions.action: Terminate the blocking PostgreSQL backend process 48213 running the 'aum-export' query using pg_terminate_backend(48213).
recommendedActions.rationale: Process 48213 is holding the exclusive row locks on payout_instructions, preventing batch PB-0909-PM from progressing.
recommendedActions.verification: Check database logs and pg_stat_activity to ensure process 48213 is terminated, and observe payout-service logs confirming lock acquisition and resumption of payout dispatch.

recommendedActions.action: Verify that batch PB-0909-PM completes dispatching all 1,987 queued redemptions or trigger a retry of the batch if aborted.
recommendedActions.rationale: 1,987 user redemption transactions have been held in pending status for over two hours.
recommendedActions.verification: Query payouts_pending metric and check payout-service logs for batch completion logs.

recommendedActions.action: Refactor the 'aum-export' query to remove 'FOR UPDATE' locking and route analytical audit exports to a read replica.
recommendedActions.rationale: Read-only audit reports should not lock rows in the primary transactional database or use FOR UPDATE semantics.
recommendedActions.verification: Review SQL definition for aum-export script and database connection routing rules.

recommendedActions.action: Enforce a schedule guard and concurrency policy in job-scheduler prohibiting heavy manual/audit jobs during operational batch windows (10:00 and 14:00 IST).
recommendedActions.rationale: Prevents accidental scheduling of heavy background jobs that compete for datastore resources during critical customer payout batches.
recommendedActions.verification: Check job-scheduler configuration validation rules and schedule restriction tests.

# Investigation report: Redemption payouts delayed

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** critic_accepted · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-09-09 at 14:00 IST (08:30 UTC), the scheduled afternoon redemption payout batch (PB-0909-PM) failed to process payouts for 1,987 users. Payout completion throughput dropped to zero, while pending payouts surged above 2,300. Around 14:19 IST (08:49:30 UTC), payout metrics dashboards also stopped updating. The incident was caused by database-level lock contention on the payout_instructions table: a one-off monthly AUM audit export job (aum-export) triggered at 13:50 IST (08:20 UTC) executed an exclusive lock query ('SELECT ... FOR UPDATE') that held row locks for hours, blocking the scheduled payout batch from acquiring write locks to execute payouts.

**Root cause:** A one-off audit export job ('aum-export') triggered via job-scheduler at 08:20:00 UTC executed a long-running 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE' transaction on the database (process 48213). This held exclusive row locks on the payout_instructions table, completely blocking the 14:00 IST (08:30:00 UTC) scheduled payout batch workers (PB-0909-PM) from acquiring RowExclusiveLock, stalling 1,987 redemptions and eventually starving payout-service's telemetry reporting pipeline.

## Hypotheses
1. **A one-off audit export job (aum-export) executed a long-running 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE' query on the database, acquiring and holding exclusive row locks on payout_instructions. This blocked the 14:00 IST scheduled payout batch (PB-0909-PM) from acquiring RowExclusiveLock to process and dispatch 1,987 redemption payouts.** — `database`, capacity_saturation, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_5, ev_7, ev_10, ev_12, ev_13, ev_14, ev_15] · Contradicting: none
   - Direct PostgreSQL database logs show process 48213 executing 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE (aum-export)' running for over 90 minutes and blocking multiple backend processes requesting RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions. Payout-service logs directly confirm that batch PB-0909-PM stalled waiting for this lock for over 7200 seconds.
2. **Partner bank API latency or failure upstream at bank-connector prevented payout dispatch.** — `bank-connector`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_4, ev_6, ev_11]
   - Bank-connector p95 latencies across all partner banks remained normal between 1700ms and 2254ms throughout the entire window, timeout rates remained baseline (<=0.6/min), and bank-connector logged zero ERROR or FATAL entries.
3. **job-scheduler failed to trigger the 14:00 IST payout batch or experienced scheduling delays.** — `job-scheduler`, infrastructure_failure, confidence 0.02, ruled_out
   - Supporting: none · Contradicting: [ev_3, ev_10]
   - job-scheduler successfully triggered job payout-batch-pm (run_40233e58) exactly at 08:30:00 UTC, and payout-service acknowledged receipt and initialized batch PB-0909-PM at 08:30:06 UTC.

## Facts
- At 2026-09-09T08:20:00.000Z (13:50 IST), a one-off job 'aum-export' (monthly AUM export for auditors) was scheduled and initiated on job-scheduler via CHG-48223. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_5]
- At 2026-09-09T08:30:00.000Z (14:00 IST), job-scheduler triggered job 'payout-batch-pm' (run_40233e58), and payout-service started batch 'PB-0909-PM' at 08:30:06Z with 1,987 queued redemptions. [ev_3, ev_10]
- Starting at 08:31:30Z and continuing past 10:41:09Z, payout-service repeatedly logged lock wait warnings on table 'payout_instructions', with wait durations exceeding 7,200 seconds. [ev_10, ev_12]
- Database logs show process 48213 executing 'SELECT ... FROM payout_instructions WHERE month = $1 FOR UPDATE (aum-export)' blocked other processes attempting to obtain RowExclusiveLock on 'payout_instructions'. [ev_13]
- payout-service metric 'payouts_completed_per_min' dropped to 0 at 08:30 UTC, while 'payouts_pending' jumped from ~226 to over 2,197 at 08:30 UTC and remained above 2,300. [ev_14, ev_15]
- payout-service metrics stopped emitting to the metrics datastore after 08:49:30 UTC. [ev_14, ev_15]
- bank-connector p95 latencies across all partner banks remained steady between 1.7s and 2.3s, timeout rates were normal (<=0.6/min), and zero ERROR logs were generated. [ev_4, ev_6, ev_11]

## Inferences
- Batch PB-0909-PM was unable to process any redemption transactions because worker threads were indefinitely blocked waiting for row locks held by the aum-export audit query. [ev_10, ev_12, ev_13, ev_15]
- The cessation of payout-service metric reporting after 08:49:30 UTC was caused by thread or database connection pool exhaustion resulting from prolonged lock wait states across backend worker threads. [ev_12, ev_13, ev_14, ev_15]
- Partner bank APIs and bank-connector played no role in the payout stall. [ev_4, ev_6, ev_11]

## Assumptions
- The aum-export job script opened an uncommitted transaction with a FOR UPDATE lock on payout_instructions that remained open throughout the entirety of its execution.
- Payout-service has a shared connection/thread pool that, when exhausted by locked batch workers, blocked the metrics reporting exporter.

## Timeline
- **2026-09-09T08:20:00.000Z (13:50 IST)** One-off job 'aum-export' scheduled and started via CHG-48223 on job-scheduler. [ev_2, ev_3]
- **2026-09-09T08:30:00.000Z (14:00 IST)** Scheduled payout batch 'payout-batch-pm' triggered by job-scheduler. [ev_3]
- **2026-09-09T08:30:06.000Z (14:00:06 IST)** payout-service begins batch PB-0909-PM with 1,987 redemption requests queued. [ev_10]
